description_sq:
Toke per shitje ne rrugen e Aeroportit .
Ndodhet ne zonen e Berxulles dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 6000 m2. 
Toka ndodhet buze rruge dhe ka mundesi mjafte te mire per cdo lloj aktiviteti biznesi. 
Prona gezon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe koeficent shfrytezimi 0.6 dhe eshte zone ku lejohet ndertimi.
Eshte zone e cila ka zhvillim mjafte te larte dhe mund te jete e pershtatshme per kapanoe, industri etj.
Per me shume informacione na kontaktoni tani !
description_en: Land for sale on Airport road. It is located in the area of ​​Berxulle and has a total area of ​​6000 m2. The land is located on the roadside and has good enough opportunities for any type of business activity. The property has regular mortgage documentation and a utilization coefficient of 0.6 and is an area where construction is allowed. It is an area which has a high level of development and can be suitable for silos, industry, etc. For more information contact us now!
